hero.eyebrow: Senior QA Tester · São Paulo, Brazil
hero.tagline: Find the bug before the player does.
hero.sub: I test AAA titles across PC and console — exploratory, smoke and regression — and I am building my automation stack with Playwright, Cypress and Selenium.
profile.title: Profile
profile.bio: I am a QA Engineer focused on software people can trust. Day to day I hunt defects in AAA games, write reports developers actually enjoy reading, and verify fixes across platforms and certification standards. Before QA I worked as a web developer and a design lead — that product eye still shapes how I test.

skills.designNote: Design roots: UI/UX, design systems, wireframing, Figma and Adobe — former Lead Designer (2020–2022). One chapter of the story, not the headline.
